action.newText: AC-11 [unit] When the GitLab merge request read returns null and no writer is verified by the matching discussion, the event is minted with writers[0] as the unverified approver.

rationale: ReviewEventMinter.mintGitLab selects verified ?? writers[0]. The corrected criterion tests the fallback without overriding that selection rule.

action.newText: AC-12 [unit] When the GitHub pull request read returns null (404) and no writer is verified by the matching thread, the event is minted with writers[0] as the unverified approver.

rationale: ReviewEventMinter.mintGitHub selects verified ?? writers[0], and the existing minter test confirms that a verified second writer takes precedence over the first writer.

action.newText: AC-1 [unit] When the approved full-import fetch returns three issues with capped: true and all three pass the allowedAuthors filter, the closure returned by VcsManualSync.prepareSyncAll resolves with fetchedIssues: 3.

rationale: VcsManualSync.prepareSyncAll already filters the fetched issues before passing them to syncIssues. The corrected criterion makes the three eligible issues explicit without changing the result contract.
